name: A Game of Thrones: The Board Game (Second Edition)

categories.label: Areas with a Castle or Stronghold
categories.hint: Victory track position. 7 areas wins immediately at any time.

categories.label: Total land areas controlled (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Tổng số vùng đất kiểm soát (hòa thì xét)
categories.hint: 1st tiebreaker: most total land areas controlled.

categories.label: Supply track position (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Vị trí track Supply (hòa thì xét)
categories.hint: 2nd tiebreaker: higher Supply track position wins.

categories.label: Iron Throne track place (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Thứ hạng track Iron Throne (hòa thì xét)
categories.hint: Final tiebreaker: place 1 is best, so the lower number wins.

tiebreakers.description: Higher position on the Supply track
Higher position on the Iron Throne track (place 1 is best)

winCondition: At the end of round 10 the House controlling the most areas with a Castle or Stronghold wins; a House controlling 7 such areas at any time wins immediately.

endCondition.description: Game ends immediately when a House controls 7 Castle/Stronghold areas; otherwise at the end of the 10th game round.

notes: family: area-control-majority. Not a point-summing game: scorer records the Victory track value (areas with a Castle or Stronghold) and the tiebreak values. Strongholds/power/supply/Iron Throne rows are tiebreak inputs only. Variant rules for 3-6 player maps not modelled.
